correctness.rationale: A proper connected subgraph of a cycle is a contiguous path, and a spanning path or full cycle exhausts the other options. The arc inclusion-exclusion formula is valid for all all cycle lengths at least three, d in 1..floor(n/2), and j in 2..n-1. Its weighted sum decreases strictly with d. Both parity-specific sums are evaluated exactly. Endpoint-leaf toggles give factors two/four; same-index and diagonal counts are separated and exceed the proposed minima. Brute enumeration of all connected edge-subgraphs for n=3..8 independently confirms every vertex profile and all far-leaf pair counts. Computation alone is not used as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The October 2026 eccentric-subgraph index motivates exact evaluations on canonical unicyclic families. The sunlet is a standard highly symmetric graph with one leaf on every cycle vertex, unlike extremal leaf-concentrated unicyclic shapes. A complete all-n vertex profile, exact parity correction, antipodal witness classification, and description of the eccentric-subgraph center provide a natural benchmark and meaningful structural information beyond a number-only exercise.
